recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core follow-up is needed unless OO reopens the broader Observation.focus model; restoring old focal-subject extension wording would be stale relative to the current core element.
issue_request: FHIR-14733 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 Observation. It asked how to represent an observation about an entity or workflow process associated with a patient, such as an implanted device, while retaining the patient link, and requested clarification of focal-subject versus Observation.subject.
initial_application: No local source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-14733. The same application family is visible through the 2018 Observation focal-subject work: d06b52856c894 added focalSubject/focal-subject guidance and 5c093b94a97 renamed the construct to Observation.focus and updated Observation notes/source text.
additional_context: FHIR-14863 formally promoted the focal-subject extension concept into Observation. The linked February 2018 Zulip thread records the rationale for keeping Observation.subject as the patient or record subject while adding focus for the actual target. Later FHIR-37736 and FHIR-43357 refined Observation.focus as a modifier and changed wording to subject-of-record with more examples; FHIR-44333 deprecated the residual code-only focus extension in the Extension Pack because Observation.focus is the current representation.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/fhir.ini actively includes Observation, and current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml plus observation-notes.xml already explain Observation.subject as the record subject and Observation.focus as another person/entity/body structure/device/DeviceMetric focus when different from the subject.
